key_decisions.decision: Keeps older sons' deaths here and identifies the new king despite name variation.
Retains pinned forty-two despite chronological difficulty; daughter remains broad kinship wording.
Retains Jehoram/Joram variation with a short identifying note.
Preserves Azariah as written here rather than silently replacing it with Ahaziah.
Retains God's role and son of Nimshi without harmonizing genealogy.
Distinguishes nephews from brothers and retains the judgment framing.
Makes multi-generation son intelligible; preserves capture location and absence of a strong successor.
Retains the sweeping slaughter report, with the rescued exception in the following verse.
Unfolds dense kinship and pronouns while preserving the woman's decisive rescue.
